editorial:
Imagine being stuck in a rundown old theater for your probation work. That is exactly where you find Vivian, a young woman trying to get her life back on track. She ends up working for Lawrence, a grumpy former Broadway director who is pretty much a nightmare to work for. The whole place feels creepy and broken, and you can tell right away that something is wrong. When Vivian finds an old tape of a Macbeth play, she accidentally lets out a scary evil force. Now, she has to team up with a local weirdo named Roddy to figure out who the killer on the tape is before it catches up to her in real life.

You will really like the acting here, especially how the tension builds between the characters. The plot moves along well, though some parts feel a bit slow until the scary stuff really kicks in. If you love ghost stories with a mystery twist, you should definitely give this a shot. You can rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night, or if you are a collector, grab the 4K Blu-ray to see all the gritty details of the theater. It is a great pick for a rainy weekend.
endingExplained: You find out that the evil spirit on the tape is tied to a dark secret from Lawrence's past. The killer isn't just a random ghost, but a result of a terrible act done years ago. In the final showdown, Vivian has to face the entity to stop the killing spree. She eventually manages to defeat the spirit, breaking the cycle of violence and allowing her to finally escape the theater and her past mistakes.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves supernatural mysteries and old theater settings.
